programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.desc: 大唐，玄武門之變後，太子李建成及其黨羽被誅。其女李長歌(迪麗熱巴)憑高超武藝逃出宮，並在追捕過程中制造「墮崖假死」而逃生，女扮男裝隱瞞身份流落民間，一心伺機誅殺李世民為父母復仇。在與突厥特勒阿史那隼(吳磊)一役中，長歌為保朔州百姓而與阿史那隼談判，自願為虜。在被阿史那隼帶往突厥後，長歌用智慧和謀略為阿史那隼解決部落紛爭，從奴隸變為幕僚。在和阿史那隼的相處過程中，長歌被這個勇猛無匹、重情重義的異族青年所吸引，兩人傾心相戀，譜寫了一曲跨越民族和文化的愛情戀歌.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.desc: 《周生如故》根據墨寶非寶原著小說《一生一世美人骨》古代篇改編，講述了坐擁數十萬大軍的異姓王爺小南辰王與清河漼氏正支唯一獨女，未來的太子妃漼時宜之間的虐戀故事.

programme.title: 斛珠夫人
programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 周生如故
programme.desc: 《周生如故》根據墨寶非寶原著小說《一生一世美人骨》古代篇改編，講述了坐擁數十萬大軍的異姓王爺小南辰王與清河漼氏正支唯一獨女，未來的太子妃漼時宜之間的虐戀故事.

programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 長安十二時辰
programme.desc: 《長安十二時辰》改編自馬伯庸的同名小説，講述了唐朝上元節前夕，長安城陷入危局，長安死囚張小敬臨危受命，與李必攜手在十二時辰內拯救長安的故事.

programme.title: 斛珠夫人
programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.desc: 浩瀚的九州大地上，大徵朝珠賦沉重，逼得漁民絞殺親子，以謀鮫女落淚而得鮫珠，沿海漁村的少女海市（楊冪飾）因此遭遇，父母亡故，全村被屠戮。生死關頭，她求助於途經此地的大徵第一權臣方諸（陳偉霆飾演），歷經考驗，最終被方諸帶回天啟。海市從此女扮男裝，成為方諸的徒弟。此時，大徵內憂外患不斷，喜怒不定的年輕皇帝褚仲旭（徐開騁飾），因為經受皇朝內亂，而對生失去了一切興趣，表面上以昏君自居，卻在方諸苦苦支撐國家和平時，暗中默默觀望這一切.

programme.title: 雪鷹領主
programme.desc: 擁有太古血脈的少年東伯雪鷹，自幼喪父、與弟弟相依為命，為救母捲入正魔爭鬥。在與魔族雲譎波詭的對抗中，雪鷹英勇無懼，屢入險境。在夏族危難之際，他初心不易，百折不屈，不斷突破自我極限。其間，雪鷹與神族後裔女子餘靖秋相識相戀，兩人歷經磨難，不畏艱險，成為知心愛人，生死與共。共同保衛夏族，守護家園，展現了夏族少年風采，最終粉碎魔族陰謀，捍衛疆土完整，書寫了一曲迴腸蕩氣的熱血神話。本劇旨在告訴年輕一代觀眾，立足於民族，立足於大愛，不忘自己的初心，方能成為真正的英雄.

programme.title: 掃毒風暴
programme.desc: 1995年，緝毒警林強峰（段奕宏 飾）結束臥底生涯，為追蹤毒品線索調任西港市禁毒支隊。彼時，走私商盧少騖（秦昊 飾）一夜間傾家蕩產，卻也因此發現冰毒的巨大利潤，心生邪念走入製販毒歧途。數年間，林強峰帶隊投身這場掃毒風暴，而盧少騁則輾轉國內外潛藏行蹤，成為最大毒梟……最終，以林強峰為代表的緝毒警不辱使命，力破盧少驍詭詐的毒網陰謀.

programme.title: 周生如故
programme.desc: 《周生如故》根據墨寶非寶原著小說《一生一世美人骨》古代篇改編，講述了坐擁數十萬大軍的異姓王爺小南辰王與清河漼氏正支唯一獨女，未來的太子妃漼時宜之間的虐戀故事.

programme.title: 偏愛之戀
programme.sub-title: 深夜走心徹聊 深情演繹偶像劇
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛.

programme.title: 17號音樂倉庫 第二季
programme.sub-title: 愛是什麼 由你定義
programme.desc: 五位全新的音樂人梁龍、胡夏、白舉綱、希林娜依·高、黃子弘凡以歌手形象反轉擔任Live House工作人員，以全新的姿態再度開啟這趟音樂旅程。同時，帶著全新口號「總有快樂發聲」，一起共同見證更多生活中的美好與驚喜.

programme.title: 危城關係
programme.desc: 以2029年為故事背景，講述了大學教授梁思木，為查清妹妹死亡的真相，通過自己研發的原始代碼文件，穿越到妹妹死亡的當天，最終與好兄弟岳凌聯手，二人憑借智慧挖掘真相，獲得成長的故事.

programme.title: 婢女
programme.desc: 講述國公府庶女沈玉清因生母被害，被迫替嫡姐與攝政王裴寂成婚。她化名媚香樓伎女夕顏接近裴寂，暗中揭露國公府與太后勾結的陰謀，同時保護自己的孩子裴昭。二人在對抗敵對勢力過程中歷經生死，最終裴寂假死脫身，與隱居民間的夕顏母子團聚.

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台.

programme.title: 有秘密的我們 第2季
programme.sub-title: 約會中突發事件女生崩潰
programme.desc: 以山野為背景，10位素人嘉賓都攜帶一個秘密進入「真相小屋」，這些秘密可能涉及過去的傷痛、未了的心願等，隨著節目推進逐漸揭曉；秘密成為推動他們情感發展的關鍵因素，也增加了未知性和驚喜感，並放棄了傳統戀綜依賴觀察室嘉賓或專家解析的模式，讓觀眾直接充當觀察者.

programme.title: 味道 第三季
programme.desc: 以美食為介質的全新文化訪談類節目，每集邀請文化名人、名廚大師、外籍帥哥、直播網紅和民間饕客一同做客飯局，在品嚐民間美味的同時，分享人生故事.

programme.title: 非來不可 第3季
programme.sub-title: 深入伊金霍洛旗化身蒙古勇士
programme.desc: 以「山河即課堂，行走即成長」為主題，由何廣智、劉奕君、李雅娟、孫藝洲、楊超越組成的「非來游學團」踏入內蒙古的草原、沙漠、礦洞與峽谷，完成了一場真實、鮮活、不設腳本的人文探索，開啟一場兼具治愈感與知識性的旅程.

programme.title: 吃在江蘇
programme.desc: 從蘇派美食的風味、特點出發，講述南北飲食的差異和地域性，將人對美食的創造和情感與江蘇的飲食文化緊密結合，呈現蘇派美食的獨有魅力.

programme.title: 姐姐當家
programme.sub-title: 謝娜母女唱雙簧哄爸爸
programme.desc: 聚焦女性主題生活觀察真人秀，邀請了謝娜、董璇、王琳與萬千惠為姐姐團成員，透過她們在「當家」過程中所面對的現實困境，探討與女性相關的選擇、情感、家庭等議題，激發出每一位女性的幽默、堅持和勇氣.

programme.title: 我是隱藏款
programme.desc: 30組新銳潮玩設計師帶著自己的原創IP，與高瀚宇、何廣智、賴美雲、謝可寅、周揚青、周震南組成3組潮玩工作室，經歷一系列主題創作，在創意與設計中不斷挑戰自我、團結協作，用繪畫表達語言，賦予這些潮流新興IP更具生命力的藝術價值，也讓更多「隱藏款」原創IP和寶藏設計師被看到.

programme.title: 萌探探探案 第三季
programme.sub-title: 黃子韜周柯宇再現蒼蘭訣
programme.desc: 沉浸式IP推理真人秀，由謝娜、黃子韜、寧靜、古力娜扎、孫紅雷、孫千、徐志勝組成「萌探家族」，他們將根據一部經典IP，進行實景還原、改編等演繹原劇片段，通過劇情的疑點及遊戲環節，獲取劇情線索，尋找劇情真相.

programme.title: 說唱夢工廠
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星.

programme.title: 我們的歌 第六季
programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾
programme.desc: 突破傳統的交友方式，24位單身女生以亮燈和滅燈方式來決定男嘉賓去留，通過「愛之初體驗」、「愛之再判斷」、「愛之終決選」、「男生權利」等決定男女嘉賓的速配成功.

programme.title: 音樂緣計劃 第2季
programme.desc: 將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台.

programme.title: 傳承人 第三季
programme.desc: 非物質文化遺產即某地區文化傳承有重要意義的行為或表現，如民俗、文化、信仰、傳統等各種智慧財產；為了全面展示保護的成果，推動高品質發展，節目打造以非物質文化遺產傳承為主題，令更多人認識及發揚光大.

programme.title: 美好生活荔枝幫
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾 第16季
programme.sub-title: 自己足夠完美才值得被愛
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 戀戀不忘的我們
programme.desc: 10位渴望愛情的單身男女共同入住「戀戀小屋」，他們中某些人將與意難平的前任重逢，重新審視自己的感情需求，探索與前任復合或開啟新戀情的可能性，在愛與成長、遺憾與釋懷的交織中，尋找理想愛情歸宿.

programme.title: 現在就出發 第3季
programme.sub-title: 港版大將軍陳偉霆斗翻王安宇
programme.desc: 出發團老成員沈騰、白敬亭、金晨、賈冰、胡先煦、王安宇、范丞丞攜手再次奔赴自然秘境，沉浸式領略各地的美麗風景；以「金木水火土」為主題線索，踏上野外探險之旅，將旅行與挑戰深度綁定，足跡從西藏林芝、齊齊哈爾等國內秘境延伸至海外極端環境.

programme.title: 新相親大會 第3季
programme.desc: 第三季重歸熒屏，新規則持續升級!「選擇心動」改為「親家宣言」，直接展現家風面貌；「權利反轉」由兩盞燈改為三盞燈，增加了嘉賓們的選擇權；新增「親家甄選」環節，刺激代際交鋒.

programme.title: 我們戀愛吧
programme.desc: 首檔郵輪戀愛真人show，六位單身男女乘坐郵輪共同旅行，通過共同相處打開心結，收穫真愛。孟非、黃菡、張純燁、郭京飛、朱正廷、程瀟等明星嘉賓組成觀察團，觀察各位單身男女在日常生活中的細節和情感走向，進行推理分析.

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第2季
programme.sub-title: 告白前夜 老孟寶兒擁抱落淚
programme.desc: 延續了上一季的基本模式，尋找一群30+都市輕熟齡男女入住 “半熟公寓”，在經歷一個月的單身公寓合租生活後，他們互相了解，走進了彼此的朋友圈、工作圈、生活圈，呈現不同的社交關係與情感發展，與陳妍希、杜海濤、喬欣、吳昕、王子文等「半熟觀察員」一起見證愛情的發生.

programme.title: 姐姐當家
programme.sub-title: 謝娜家庭聚餐全家飆戲
programme.desc: 聚焦女性主題生活觀察真人秀，邀請了謝娜、董璇、王琳與萬千惠為姐姐團成員，透過她們在「當家」過程中所面對的現實困境，探討與女性相關的選擇、情感、家庭等議題，激發出每一位女性的幽默、堅持和勇氣.

programme.title: 荔枝遊天下
programme.desc: 融合國內外優質旅遊資源，以多元視角帶領觀眾領略世界之美，為你提供不一樣的特色文化旅遊產品.

programme.title: 王牌對王牌 第八季
programme.sub-title: 沈騰華晨宇「慶祝」熬走賈玲
programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂.

programme.title: 17號音樂倉庫 第二季
programme.sub-title: 梁龍胡夏彈唱光陰的故事
programme.desc: 五位全新的音樂人梁龍、胡夏、白舉綱、希林娜依·高、黃子弘凡以歌手形象反轉擔任Live House工作人員，以全新的姿態再度開啟這趟音樂旅程。同時，帶著全新口號「總有快樂發聲」，一起共同見證更多生活中的美好與驚喜.

programme.title: 我們的歌 第五季
programme.sub-title: 大張偉Amber音樂盛典放大招
programme.desc: 在音樂主題上再度突破，以「一路為伍，向生綻放」為主題，甄選了貼近生活的歌曲和作品，用歌聲傳遞正能量；邀請了A-Lin、大張偉、庾澄慶、馬嘉祺、光良、蘇慧玲、任賢齊、陳卓璇、曾比特、白舉綱、吳莫愁等老、中、青三代歌手，在全新升級的「盲選配對」模式中組合獻唱，在代際傳承、時代交融中突破自我，打造一場最溫暖、最動人的音樂盛宴.

programme.title: 婢女
programme.desc: 講述國公府庶女沈玉清因生母被害，被迫替嫡姐與攝政王裴寂成婚。她化名媚香樓伎女夕顏接近裴寂，暗中揭露國公府與太后勾結的陰謀，同時保護自己的孩子裴昭。二人在對抗敵對勢力過程中歷經生死，最終裴寂假死脫身，與隱居民間的夕顏母子團聚.

programme.title: 百姓的味道
programme.desc: 美食紀錄類真人秀，由謝霆鋒擔任「美食尋味官」，與嘉賓一起探尋、領略各地風土人情、壯麗山河，品嘗民間百味；在野趣橫生的自然和充滿煙火氣的城市中，尋覓中國百姓生活，解讀百味人生.

programme.title: 非來不可 第3季
programme.desc: 以「山河即課堂，行走即成長」為主題，由何廣智、劉奕君、李雅娟、孫藝洲、楊超越組成的「非來游學團」踏入內蒙古的草原、沙漠、礦洞與峽谷，完成了一場真實、鮮活、不設腳本的人文探索，開啟一場兼具治愈感與知識性的旅程.

programme.title: 了不起! 舞社 第二季

programme.title: 非凡搭檔
programme.desc: 由黎明、林依晨、魏晨、謝依霖、鄭元暢、盛一倫、朱珠、李小鵬、王濛、潘曉婷、唐曉天、陳楚河共十二位明星和奧運冠軍參加，以輪換搭檔的形式，在全球十二座體育城市展開一系列競技PK.

programme.title: 主廚的榮耀：中餐季
programme.sub-title: 打破專業局限追求熱愛
programme.desc: 聚焦18名來自全國一線「主廚」通過不同對戰形式挑戰各類美食命題，加深著觀眾對廚師技能、主廚職業、飲食文化的多重認知。邀請到四位餐飲界頂級大師董振祥、周曉燕、譚綺文、劉一帆，以及代表食客和經營餐飲店的演員袁弘組成評委團，從不同的角度對主廚創作進行品評，見證主廚形象的誕生.

programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: 有秘密的我們 第2季
programme.sub-title: 矛盾升級 拒絕原諒
programme.desc: 以山野為背景，10位素人嘉賓都攜帶一個秘密進入「真相小屋」，這些秘密可能涉及過去的傷痛、未了的心願等，隨著節目推進逐漸揭曉；秘密成為推動他們情感發展的關鍵因素，也增加了未知性和驚喜感，並放棄了傳統戀綜依賴觀察室嘉賓或專家解析的模式，讓觀眾直接充當觀察者.

programme.title: 新相親大會 第3季
programme.desc: 第三季重歸熒屏，新規則持續升級!「選擇心動」改為「親家宣言」，直接展現家風面貌；「權利反轉」由兩盞燈改為三盞燈，增加了嘉賓們的選擇權；新增「親家甄選」環節，刺激代際交鋒.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 王牌對王牌 第八季
programme.sub-title: 王牌荒島生存大賽開啟「賽車之夜
programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂.

programme.title: 我們的歌 第四季
programme.desc: 在主題上進一步升級，以「光陰的故事」為核心大主題，甄選時代經典金曲；邀請了陳慧嫻、楊坤、周傳雄等為前輩歌手，而張淇、蕭敬騰、安又琪、陸虎、孟慧圓、馬嘉祺等為中生代歌手與新聲歌手；通過「盲選配對」的方式組合獻唱，激活樂壇無限能量，打造更多金曲.

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: 危城關係
programme.desc: 以2029年為故事背景，講述了大學教授梁思木，為查清妹妹死亡的真相，通過自己研發的原始代碼文件，穿越到妹妹死亡的當天，最終與好兄弟岳凌聯手，二人憑借智慧挖掘真相，獲得成長的故事.

programme.title: 婢女
programme.desc: 講述國公府庶女沈玉清因生母被害，被迫替嫡姐與攝政王裴寂成婚。她化名媚香樓伎女夕顏接近裴寂，暗中揭露國公府與太后勾結的陰謀，同時保護自己的孩子裴昭。二人在對抗敵對勢力過程中歷經生死，最終裴寂假死脫身，與隱居民間的夕顏母子團聚.

programme.title: 嗨！唱起來
programme.desc: 全新互動音樂節目，以「星素結合」的形式全民共唱。100位素人歌手將通過現場K歌贏得機會成為三位幸運歌手，與每集的大咖歌手進行合唱挑戰，實現自己的夢想。大咖歌手嘉賓包括孫楠、羽泉等.

programme.title: 非誠勿擾 第16季
programme.sub-title: 探討愛情裡的深度交流

programme.title: 野挺有趣
programme.sub-title: 黃宗澤張嘉元猜歌猜出表情包
programme.desc: 社區生活體驗真人秀；黃宗澤、陳卓璇、李雅娟、王勉、張嘉元、張小婉等嘉賓接受委托，化身為活動策劃團隊，通過改造場地、邀請遊客、開辦集會等方式，把裡予社區逐步構建成集藝術、環保、潮流為一體的青年文化聚集地；打造一場場「奇趣」的社交活動，呈現當代年輕人「野plus」般態度表達的綜藝盛宴.

programme.title: 說唱夢工廠
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星.

programme.title: 我們的歌 第六季
programme.sub-title: 各國年輕歌手 燃情開唱
programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴.

programme.title: 第一刑事部的烏鴉
programme.desc: Two years have passed since Michio Irima left first criminal court (commonly known as “Ichikei”). Michio is transferred to Setouchi in Okayama Prefecture, where he is assigned to an assault case involving the youngest Minister of Defense in history. His investigations lead him to look into a collision incident involving an Aegis warship, but the details of the ships voyage are a national secret. Michio is now faced with an adversary upon which the threat of “official authority” does not work. Meanwhile, Chizuru Sakama, who has tried numerous cases with Michio, is working as a lawyer in a neighboring town under a work experience program. There, she takes on a case involving a large local company which supports the whole town, but not all is as it seems...Between these seemingly disparate cases, a shocking truth arises. Are they opening a Pandora's Box that was best left alone?

programme.title: 爆谷巨星匯：古天樂: 使徒行者
programme.desc: When undercover agent Ding receives an encrypted message from Blackjack, who claims to be an undercover agent that has lost contact with the police, she reports it to her superior officer Inspector Q, who immediately launches a mission to search for Blackjack. During the mission, Ding visits a casino where she discovers that the supposedly dead triad leader Foon-hei is surprisingly alive and kicking. Meanwhile, Inspector Q narrows down Blackjack's whereabouts when he learns of a finance group's involvement in a drug deal in Brazil. The deal involves company chairman Kwok Ming, his advisor Lam, Lam's right-hand man Shiu and Foon-hei, who is plotting a comeback to the crime world. When the players learn of an undercover agent in their midst, paranoia and distrust begin to cloud over the deal..

programme.title: 愛在安娜普納峰
programme.desc: On a sunny spring day, Kang Hyun goes hiking in Bugaksan Mountain with Sun Woo who has been recently discharged from the military. It is already past noon but they continue a casual conversation about their past relationships while hiking along trails. Kang Hyun reminisces about the bittersweet memories of his exes ‘Anna' and ‘Eun Chae', while Sun Woo regrets treating his ex ‘Eun Jung' badly and blames his immaturity in the past relationship with ‘Pureum'.Kang Hyun and Sun Woo come across different people along the trail. They pass by a good-looking woman in tight leggings who instantly capture their eyes. They also come across a middle-aged man who gives disappointing hiking tips, which make them feel hopeless. ‘Anna' and ‘Pureum' incarnate our bygone lovers who we once strongly admired but failed to reach.Though hiking is as tough as life can be, it can also bring you joy because some people come into our lives and make us happy. programme.title: 七劍
programme.desc: In the early 1660's the Manchurians took over the sovereignty of China and established the Qing Dynasty. With many pro-nationalist revolts occurring, the newly set-up government immediately imposed a ban on the study and practice of the Martial Arts. Fire-wind, a military official from the previous dynasty, ravages and ranges across North-western China with his next goal to attack the final frontier - the intransigent and hold-out town know as the Martial Village. Fu Qinghu, a retired executioner from the previous dynasty, feels a moral obligation to try and put a stop to this brutality and decides to save Martial Village. He convinces two young people from the village to travel with him to Mount Heaven in order to seek help from Master Shadow-Glow, a hermit who is a master of swords and leads a group of disciples with unimaginable swordsmanship..

programme.title: 浪漫特攻隊

During her holiday on a South Pacific Island, she gets married to Jonathan, a tycoon who she initially thought of as her prince charming but turns out to be a control freak. With the help of her neighbour Beom-wu, who happens to be a die-hard fan of Yeo-rae, she is going to get herself out of the cage with a murder plan.

programme.title: 爆谷獨家首播：百變靚靚: OMG！阿媽有喜
programme.desc: Rita, 53, and her husband Siu Hung were planning their retirement when they suddenly discovered that they were pregnant! Both the couple wanted to have the child removed, but they didn't know how to tell each other. Until at a family dinner, two children accidentally discovered the secret of their mother, and the reaction was uproar. At the same time, Siu Hung's sister-Fuk Ling returned from abroad and decided to move in with everyone. The incompatible relationship between sister-in-law and sister-in-law suddenly plunged the Lee family into a chaotic dispute. In anger, Rita decided to become a senior mother and decided to give birth to the child in her belly. The peaceful and well-off family began an unprecedented 'big reform'. However, during this wonderful pregnancy process, everyone began to become different because of this sudden little life...including Fuk Ling, who had been married for many years but did not want to have children; his otaku son who was not good at expre.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -跨越四徑挑戰
programme.desc: Among Hong Kong's trail running community, there is a legendary mountain race that runners have to complete in total distance of 298km in 72 hours. Without any cash-prize or award for this challenge, passionate runners keep challenging their own perseverance. Director Robin Lee has won the Best New Director award at the Hong Kong Film Awards for his debut documentary “Four Trails”. In this interview, Lee together with runner Jacky Leung will talk about their stories of pain and glory brought by this extreme challenge.

programme.title: 東京復仇者2 血腥萬聖節篇–命運
programme.desc: “I'll save you! Over and over! I'll never give up until I find a future where you're still alive!” Takemichi thought he had saved his ex-girlfriend Hinata...but once again, she was killed by the Tokyo Manji Gang, an organization that had grown violent and corrupt. This time, she was killed right in front of his eyes... The key to saving Hinata was linked to a tragic event that had torn apart the six founding members of Tokyo Manji... Six best friends who swore to die for one another. Why did they turn against each other? The epic battle on Halloween, October 31, would pit best friends against each other and threaten to destroy the Tokyo Manji Gang.

programme.title: 証人
programme.desc: A traffic accident changed their lives forever. In capturing wanted criminal Zhang Yidong, Sergeant Tang Fei was involved in a gunfight and car accident that put the criminal in a coma. But in the process he also crippled an fellow officer, and mistakenly shot dead the elder daughter of public prosecutor and single mother Gao Min. Unable to handle the guilt, Tang Fei succumbs to a fog of pain. Gao Min, meanwhile, pours all her love and attention to her younger daughter Ling. Three months later, the criminal Zhang Yidong awakens from his coma. Gao Min, who had been working hard on bringing him to justice, insists he stand trial immediately.

programme.title: 片場職人 -麥兆輝
programme.desc: Graduated from acting major, Alan Mak has been cultivating in the film industry for over three decades and often serving as director or screenwriter. He created numerous remarkable films such as “Infernal Affairs” and “Overheard 3” that not only earned him notable recognition in the form of awards but also demonstrated his curiosity toward human nature. In this episode, he is going to revisit and dissect the film universe through his works.....

programme.title: 深夜咖啡屋：消失了愛人
programme.desc: Bride-to-be Yoon waits for her groom Tae-young on their wedding day but he doesn't show up. Out of concern and anger, she searches for him all day and in the dead of night, she arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight', which opens from midnight until the sun rises. Upon entering Yoon finally finds Tae-young, but something doesn't seem right. He looks a few years younger and he doesn't even recognize her. As past, present and future merge, will the bride find her groom.

programme.title: 新宿事件
programme.desc: The foreign migrant communities in Tokyo live shadowy lives. The Japanese neither acknowledge nor welcome them. They are shunned by the mainstream society, hounded by the yakuza, and go about their days under fear of being discovered and repatriated. It is an alien world for Steelhead – an honest, hardworking tractor repairman. Steelhead had decided to take the perilous journey to Tokyo after he lost contact with his girlfriend, who had arrived in the city earlier.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -打開世外大門
programme.desc: “Another World”, the Hong Kong animation nominated for the Annecy International Animation Film Festival (also known as the Oscars of animation), is a heartfelt seven-year labour of love. In this interview, its screenwriter-producer Polly Yeung and Art director Step C. share the behind-the-scenes stories. Polly recounts her moment of tears on the nomination and the intention of its theme and character design. Step C. also reveals their feeling of frustrations like giving-up that comes along with the challenges of completing this project.

programme.title: 寒戰2
programme.desc: The story of this highly-anticipated sequel continues as Acting Police Commissioner Sean Lau (Aaron Kwok) is promoted to the highest rank in the police force. Joe (Eddie Peng Yuyan), son of Deputy Police Commissioner Waise Lee (Tony Leung Ka Fai) who is behind the conspiracy, is taken into custody and Waise is forced to retire. But Master, Themind remains unknown, until the resurface of a former police chief who unveils an unprecedented scheme to corrupt the police force. Things get more complicated when senior counsel Oswald Kan (Chow Yun Fat) leads an impeachment proceeding against Sean. Oswald's every decision is pivotal in determining who stays on top of the game.

programme.title: LAST MILE：全面引爆
programme.desc: On the day before the Black Friday sale, a box delivered by a global e-commerce company, explodes. The box was sent from one of the biggest warehouses, which has the three-quarter logistic shares around Tokyo. It leads a series of mysterious bombings that terrorize whole of Japan. Elena Funado, who was just appointed as a new director of the warehouse, is forced to control this unprecedented situation with a line manager, Ko Nashimoto. Who planted the bombs? For what purpose? How many bombs are left? - And where are they now? In this modern society, distribution service becomes critical need for our lives and that cannot be stopped. Can Elena and Ko end the serial bombings without stopping blood flowed in “blood vessel”; the global logistics system like a web.

programme.title: 烏托邦浩劫
programme.desc: The world has been reduced to rubble by a massive earthquake.While no one knows for sure how far the ruins stretch, or what the cause of the earthquake may be, in the heart of Seoul there is only one apartment building left standing. It is called Hwang Gung Apartments. As time passes, outsiders start coming in to Hwang Gung Apartments trying to escape the extreme cold. Before long, the apartment residents are unable to cope with the increasing numbers. Feeling a threat to their very survival, the residents enact a special measure.

programme.title: 超越
programme.desc: Tianyi Wu, a young 100-meter-running champion, returns to his hometown, aiming to get off his chest the failure to surpass his former teammate, Chaoyue Hao. But he doesn't expect to see that Chaoyue's life is in shambles as well. They retreat to the memories of their lives, both shared and separate, in an attempt to lift each other up from their current situation.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -踢出逆轉勝
programme.desc: The film “Pass and Goal”, collaborated by Gigi Leung, Peter Chan, Ling Man Lung and Rachel Leung, brings a blend of laughter, passion and inspiration. Gigi has burst out laughing when recalled funny scenes from the film. While Man Lung tells that he seemed like a scolded kid during a scene together with Gigi, Rachel also reveals a stunning reason of taking her role and Peter even names Gigi as a “new comedy star held up by romantic film”.

programme.title: 臨時決鬥
programme.desc: “CHUNG LUI SOCIETY” is a boxing gym founded by the former legendary Muay Thai champion CHUNG Lui, who is dedicated to training professional fighters. Despite the gym's struggles, he remains committed to his lifelong philosophy of never backing down from a challenge. Businesswoman Elsa discovers that her boyfriend Daniel is cheating on her with Macau's female champion, Surewin. Driven by her competitive spirit, Elsa vows to settle their score in the ring. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. Upon learning that Surewin was Lui's former student, Elsa seeks him out to train her at his gym. There, she encounters MOK Ka Lei, who had previously clashed with her during an advertisement shoot. After leaving the entertainment industry to support her family, Ka Lei attempts to make a comeback, with the help of her friend LAM Pik Chu. Under the rigorous training of Lui's protege, KO Chau, Elsa undergoes intense preparation. Alth.

programme.title: 激戰
programme.desc: After a stint in prison for participating in underground boxing, Fai is knee-deep in debt with no solution in sight. To escape his debtors, he flees to Macau and works as a gym assistant. He meets and ends up training Si-Qi, a hot-blooded young man who enrolled in an open MMA competition with no fighting experience. After a series of wins, Si-Qi is critically injured and eliminated from the tournament. Ignited by Si-Qi's persistence and unwillingness to give up in the face of defeat, he rediscovers his will to fight and steps back in the ring against the fighter who injured his student..

programme.title: 非分熟女
programme.desc: Born in a culinary family, Siu Man has always led an ideal life - Good grades, a financially viable job and a loving husband. But one thing has always plagued her: A fear of intimacy. After the end of her sexless marriage and several life crises, Siu Man reboots her life by taking over her father's restaurant. She hires Jiahao, a ‘culinary philosopher' who takes a creative approach to cooking. To help save the restaurant, Jiahao decides to mentor Siu Man, opening her up to his culinary world. In the process, Siu Man becomes attracted to his masculinity, intelligence and his mastery of culinary skills. After seeing her usually conservative friends let loose at a wedding party, Siu Man realizes that it's time to tackle her fear of intimacy head-on. With the help of a new friend, Siu Man embarks on a journey of liberation, starting with pole dancing lessons and returning to the dating scene. When she secretly spies on Jiahao's wild tryst with another woman, Siu Man finally exper.

programme.title: 左輪殺姬
programme.desc: 'I'm getting the money I'm owed, why should I prepare myself? ”Su-young, a police officer waiting to move into her dream apartment, gets entangled in an unexpected corruption case. She accepts an offer to take all the blame in exchange for a large reward. Two years later, on the day of her release from prison, the only person who comes to see her is Yoon-sun, a woman she has never met before. Su-young senses that something has gone wrong. Determined to regain everything she has lost, Su-young sets out to find Andy, who promised her the reward, but she soon encounters an even bigger and more dangerous force behind him..

programme.title: 猛鬼3寶
programme.desc: This anthology film features a triplet of horror stories starring up-and-coming actors and popular local Youtubers. When a film crew is haunted by paranormal activities, the director decides to cast her to play a ghost; When a taxi driver takes his girlfriend to a party room to get it on, a horny ghost adds spice to the proceedings; When a wandering ghost refuses to leave a soon-to-be-gentrified mall, the tenants concoct a plan to send her off.

programme.title: 重案行動之限時拯救
programme.desc: Police Force - Commercial Crime Bureau has been investigating Jufeng's finance for many years, but all failed due to insufficient evidence. In order to collect evidence, the Commercial Crime Bureau sent an informant to Jufeng. But when the informant successfully entered Jufeng Computer and stole the account, the immediate supervisor Sir Ren died mysteriously. Sir Chong started to take over the case..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -回望秋名山飛車歲月
programme.desc: Celebrating the 20th anniversary of release of the classic film 'Initial D', Director Andrew Lau fondly recalls his first impression on Jay Chou that had been completely changed after an incident and also reveals how dangerous when Jay crashed the AE86 on set. In this episode, the film's creative team looks back on the unforgettable moments of the filming day and reveal to us the unknown behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: 潛行
programme.desc: In the new century, the fight against drugs faces an unprecedented and difficult challenge! Under the deep and complex dark network, an invisible war is being waged in Hong Kong...... Typhoon signal was hoisted in Hong Kong. Under the cover of the fierce wind, four tons of methamphetamine were entering Hong Kong, pending to be sold on the dark network. A cyber revelry of druggies was about to be unveiled, and a storm was brewing in the quiet Victoria Harbour. Police had to arrest the “boss” behind the scenes and nip the “drug network” in the bud in no time, that pushed their undercover intelligence to the narrow road. In the center of the storm, undercover agents, police officers, drug lords, black, white, and gray entangled.

programme.title: 王的盛宴
programme.desc: The early history of a nation unfolds through the actions of three heroes – Liu Bang, Xiang Yu and Han Xin – who chased their dreams of uniting a warring nation and fought through major milestones of the Chu-Han Contention years in the third century. From the Julu War to the Hongmen Banquet, the Gaixia War to the death of HanXin, the narration of Liu Bang – who would be the founding emperor of the new Han Dynasty – sets the stage for a tale of betrayal and brothers at war, where the last man standing inherits a nation.

programme.title: 無雙
programme.desc: Lee Man, a member of a notorious money counterfeiting ring, is arrested in Thailand and extradited back to Hong Kong. Thanks to renowned painter Yuen Man, Lee is offered a deal by the police: Reveal the identity of Painter, the charismatic leader of the counterfeiting ring, and Yuen can bail him out. Lee has no choice but to comply and recount his story. In the 1990s, Lee and Yuen were lovers living together in Vancouver, seeking to be seen in the art world. However, success eludes them, and Lee is forced to go make counterfeit paintings to make a living. Lee's counterfeit paintings catch the eyes of Painter, and he decides to recruits Lee to join his team. Together with Painter's elite team, Lee travels the world in search of technologies to create the “Super Dollar,” a counterfeit bill that circumvents the anti-counterfeiting measures of the 1996 American dollar. But when Lee witnesses Painter's violent methods in action, he becomes desperate to escape his employer's grip.

programme.title: 人間蒸發
programme.desc: Jia Jia went to Japan with her fiance to meet her family. As soon as she arrived at the foot of Mount Fuji, she was imprisoned by local villagers and led an inhuman life. The cowardly Hirota only knew how to sorrow through wine. Jia Jia's good sister Wei Ling resolutely went to Japan to find Jia Jia. With the help of agent Kinoshita, the investigation gradually deepened, but the surrounding environment became more and more sinister. Hirota was strangled to death in a hot spring pool. Michiko went mad because of extreme fear. Yuko was still sane but unable to express when she was attacked. Tadao often spied Wei Ling through the cracks in the door. Residents under the shadow of nuclear radiation gradually lost their humanity, like a hyena, and ready to bite Wei Ling this outsider.

programme.title: 暴瘋語
programme.desc: Three years ago, FAN (LAU Ching Wan) had a schizophrenic breakdown and killed his wife (Michelle YE Xuan). He later attempted to commit suicide but was unsuccessful, and was eventually sentenced to rehabilitate in a psychiatric facility indefinitely. Dr. CHOW (HUANG Xiao Ming) is FAN's psychiatrist. He believes FAN is cured after 3-year treatment and is alone in opposition to all doctors' objections to discharge FAN. After releasing from the facility, FAN faces discrimination and misunderstanding and once again finds himself at the brink of collapse. One night, he mistakenly kills a drug addict on impulse. He is driven to despair and comes to Dr. CHOW for help.Having thought about it, Dr CHOW fears his career will be wrecked if it is uncovered and therefore helps FAN abscond. The concealment of the truth subtly snowballs into chaos as it triggers media criticism and attacks due to his missing murderous patient. In order to redeem himself, CHOW decides to cure FAN with a confi.

programme.title: 脫單香氣神助攻
programme.desc: Chang-soo, a guy who has never been in a romantic relationship, earns a magical power after accidentally wearing a perfume he receives from a stranger. The supernatural power he earns is what any man would dream of, an ability to attract every woman in the world! Ara, a woman Chang-soo has been in love with, begins to sense the scent of Chang-soo and falls in love with him. While they gradually grow their connection, Ara's ex-boyfriend, James, suddenly appears and reveals Chang-soo's secret! Will the two people overcome this predicament and find true love in each other.

programme.title: 愛情萬歲
programme.desc: Ching and Sung work in “Love Cafe” in the dazzling Soho and the main job is to cure broken hearts. But happiness won't last forever. After gathering with schoolmates, where Ching's ex-boyfriend Hung showed up, depute between Ching and Sung breaks out and their plan to study in Beijing almost vanishes... Joe met Kelly in a disco and falls into her in the first sight. However, Kelly is in fact a weapon of Joe's ex-girlfriend for revenge. But the more Kelly knows about Joe, the less she can pull herself out of the relationship... Yu has a handsome and career type boyfriend who will buy her everything. But what she needs is care which can't be bought. Sing, having a crush on Yu, always stands by her and comforts her desperate heart. But their 6-year age difference seems a gap that Yu couldn't step forward.

programme.title: 光影無間「導」—麥兆輝: 頭文字Ｄ
programme.desc: Takumi delivers tofu in father's old Toyota every day and unwittingly acquires difting skills. An unexpected victory awakens his competitive genes, leading him to fierce races.

programme.title: 成功補習班
programme.desc: The year is 1994. As the life-changing college examination looms on the horizon for Heng and his two best friends, they spend their days pulling pranks at their cram school, obsessing over sex and stressing over their uncertain futures. However, the cram school's new tutor, Teacher Chih, manages to tame the wild trio and helps them discover their true selves.

programme.title: 驅魔黑修女
programme.desc: Are you ready to venture into the forbidden? Sister Giunia is convinced that the evil spirit possessing Hee-joon is one of the 12 Manifestations. With the exorcist priest unable to come in time and Hee-joon's life clearly at risk, Sister Giunia decides to break a sacred rule: ‘An unordained nun cannot perform an exorcism.' However, Father Paolo, Hee-joon's attending physician, firmly believes that only medicine can save the boy. When Sister Giunia discovers a secret about Father Paolo's disciple, Sister Michela, she recklessly seeks her help to smuggle Hee-joon out of the hospital. Despite clashing with the fearless Giunia, Michela, feeling a connection to the boy, decides to join forces. Together, the two nuns embark on a dangerous ritual, determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. There's only one rule: Save him at all cost.

programme.title: 大追捕
programme.desc: When a Hong Kong celebrity is found brutally murdered, detective Lam is called in to take charge. But the more that Lam pursues his suspect, the deeper he falls into a web of lies.

programme.title: 芳寸之地
programme.desc: For Sarya (17), a Kurdish refugee girl in Japan, life seems to be looking up; her grades at school are enough to pursue college, she's surrounded with good friends and her relationship with Sota is becoming special. Sarya's life becomes upside down, however, when she learns that her family's refugee status is turned down, restricting her family from work and traveling across the city. Her father, who had continued to work to sustain a living, is taken into custody for illegal employment. Sarya is now suddenly forced into a situation where she is responsible not only for her younger siblings but for her very existence.

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -跨越四徑挑戰
programme.desc: Among Hong Kong's trail running community, there is a legendary mountain race that runners have to complete in total distance of 298km in 72 hours. Without any cash-prize or award for this challenge, passionate runners keep challenging their own perseverance. Director Robin Lee has won the Best New Director award at the Hong Kong Film Awards for his debut documentary “Four Trails”. In this interview, Lee together with runner Jacky Leung will talk about their stories of pain and glory brought by this extreme challenge.

programme.title: 破墓
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, the renowned shaman Hwa-rim and her protege Bong-gil are commissioned with a hefty sum to meet the enigmatic descendants of a household afflicted by a peculiar illness. Sensing the ominous aura surrounding the ancestral grave, Hwa-rim urges for its relocation. The best geomancer in the business, Sang-duk, and mortician Young-geun, lured by the scent of money, join the team. The mysterious grave, situated in an unapproachable sacred ground, holds dark secrets. Though Sang-duk senses an ominous presence and initially rejects the proposal, Hwa-rim's persuasion ultimately initiates the exhumation, leading to a journey where the team must confront both supernatural forces and their own fears.

programme.title: 親愛的
programme.desc: When their son goes missing, TIAN and his ex-wife find their lives thrown into turmoil. Years later, they have been tipped to find their lost son, but he sees them as strangers..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -每逢過節有過節
programme.desc: As broken as it is, can the family get together for a festive dinner to celebrate the winter solstice? As complicated as it is, is human relationship a cure or a burden to the already tough life that we are forced to endure? Director Eric Tsang along with the leading casts of Hong Kong Family – Teresa Mo, Tse Kwan-ho and Hedwig Tam, gathered in this interview to share the insights they gained from producing the movie, as well as the emotional journeys as they dived into each characters' inner struggles and sorrowful pasts. Watch this episode of Baogu Produces to learn the way of getting along with your so close yet so far family members.

programme.title: 過時．過節
programme.desc: The chaos began at the Winter Solstice dinner eight years ago. The father lost his temper, the son, not able to forgive his father, ran away from home. Eight years have passed, and the family's relationship is still cold and distant. A cousin returns to Hong Kong from England and hopes to gather everyone for a Winter Solstice dinner. The long-awaited gathering prompted everyone to rethink their relationships with family members. Some choose to leave, some are back. When things are about to fall apart, it might as well be an opportunity to mend connections.

programme.title: 唱K吧！黑道之哥
programme.desc: Yakuza member Narita is consumed by only one thing: how to survive his boss' annual karaoke competition. Desperate to avoid his boss' cruel and unusual punishment for losing, Narita recruits junior high school choir member Oka to teach him how to sing. The trouble is, Narita is impossibly hopeless as a singer. The stakes may be low, but Yamashita Nobuhiro's deadpan approach to an unlikely friendship and Ayano Go's hilariously self-deprecating performance make this a winning comedy that will inspire you to hit the karaoke box. Rarely has the butchering beloved pop classics ever been funnier.

programme.title: 不義之戰
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Inspector Tam Ka Ming, Hei and Special Female Force team Madam, Shirley and a group of commandos started a secret operation to chase a group of gangster across the border of Hong Kong. This led to a large and drawn-out firefight between the police and gangsters, resulting in Shirley and a number of commandos killed in operation. The incident caused Inspector Tam and Madam Fong having a nightmare in these twenty years. Twenty years later, an escort operation bringing Inspector Tam and Madam Fong with four new-generation Special Female Force teammate Alma, Zi Han, Sheila, and Tong Yu to Macau, a group of gangster stormed the operation and they find Hei is still alive..

programme.title: 不再讓你孤單
programme.desc: When they first meet, no one can see this coming. She is a young, aggressive Beijing-based real estate agent from Hong Kong carrying an affair with a married man who also happens to be her boss. He is an honest but way too rigid policeman in his midlife crisis, who remains single to take care of his kid brother. A chance encounter in a karaoke lounge leads to an unlikely friendship. While he becomes infatuated with her, finding her pronunciation of his name the most dulcet tune he has ever heard, she is wrestling with being dumped by her boss and fired from her job at the same time. She eventually runs off to Hong Kong after borrowing almost his entire savings..

programme.title: 精武家庭
programme.desc: A mysterious person arrived in his wheelchair in Yue's Clinic and asked for a person called Tai Chi Lung. Later on, Yue was found disappeared, leaving behind his clinic a mess..

programme.title: 光影無間「導」—麥兆輝: 無間道
programme.desc: This is a story between the mole in the police department, Ming(Andy Lau) and the undercover cop, Yan(Tony Leung), who are competing to uncover each other first..

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 殺人預言
programme.desc: One day, the dead body of Min-tae only brother Seok-tae was found, and Seok-tae ‘s wife Moon-young has disappeared. While searching for clues on this brother's death, Min-tae found that a novelist Ho-ryung also following the same trail and he discovered that the death of his brother was predicted in Ho-ryung's bestselling novel, ‘Nocturnal.' Min-tae was thrown into confusion and brother's gang and police also getting involved in the case. To find out the truth behind brother's death, Min-tae began a relentless and furious pursuit..

programme.title: 爆谷製造 -踢出逆轉勝
programme.desc: The film “Pass and Goal”, collaborated by Gigi Leung, Peter Chan, Ling Man Lung and Rachel Leung, brings a blend of laughter, passion and inspiration. While Man Lung tells that he seemed like a scolded kid during a scene together with Gigi, Rachel also reveals a stunning reason of taking her role and Peter even names Gigi as a “new comedy star held up by romantic film”.

programme.title: 黑的教育
programme.desc: On the night of their high school graduation, three juvenile delinquents find themselves getting drunk at their regular hangout, throwing beer bottles and enjoying the abuse hurled at them by nearby residents. But for these young men about to enter a new chapter of life, this little bit of chaos is nowhere near enough to farewell their dying youth. Before dawn, they decide to share their deepest, darkest secret with one another. After all, only true “bros” are qualified to know their most unspeakable deed..

programme.title: 死屍死時四十四
programme.desc: A dead body and a hotchpotch of homeowners in a residential building on a single night: all hell breaks loose. As the Jewish axiom has it, “man thinks; God laughs.” On a night like any other, Ming, together with his wife and mother-in-law, finds an anonymous naked dead body lying at their doorstep. They might not know who the body was, but they have no doubt that their unit will become a “murder home” once this is exposed. Its property value will nosedive, and they will be transformed from blissful homeowners to miserable victims. So they decide to pass the buck to their neighbours. There are eleven living residents in four units on the same floor. Besides Ming's family of five, there are the retired elderly couple, Mr. & Mrs. Chan; the single lady Mary and her maid; and the Cheung's, an irascible father and his cantankerous son. Last but not least, there is this mysterious woman from an upper floor who chain smokes. This motley group of residents start fighting against one a.

programme.title: 燈火闌珊
programme.desc: Widow Mei-heung has gone through countless sleepless nights since the death of her husband, Bill. One day, she finds a key among the items that Bill left behind, leading her to his secret neon workshop and his young apprentice, Leo. She learns from Leo that Bill had an unfulfilled last wish–to recreate a demolished legendary neon sign. With Leo's help, Mei-heung tries to uncover the story behind the sign and learns the craft of blowing neon lights in hopes of fulfilling her deceased husband's last wish with her own hands. Along the way, Mei-heung reminisces about her beautiful encounters with Bill and unearths pieces of Bill's past as if they are the last consolation left by him. Meanwhile, Mei-heung's daughter, Prism, plans to leave Hong Kong with her fiance, but she is unable to break the news to Mei-heung. As clues of the legendary neon sign gradually emerge, the secrets that Mei-heung couldn't face are about to be revealed..

programme.title: 點對點
programme.desc: Chung returns from Canada to a drastically transformed Hong Kong and hoping to capture the city in his childhood years, graffitis a cryptic diagram near every subway station, in the form of dot-to-dot games. Soon they are discovered by Xue, a Putonghua teacher from China determined to solve these riddles as she immerses herself in our city's culture and history..

programme.title: 戀愛大都會
programme.desc: Searching for true love in this prejudiced world. Jae-hee is a free-spirited girl who often becomes the center of rumors, while her classmate Heung-soo struggles to hide his true identity. One night at the bar district, Jae-hee discovers the other side of Heung-soo that no one else knows and helps him keep it a secret in public. As Heung-soo accidentally becomes Jae-hee's roommate, they realize that despite not being each other's ideal types, their companionship fosters a deep and strong friendship. Together, they navigate life's unexpected challenges and rely on each other like family as they courageously pursue their own paths in love and life.

programme.title: 西遊記之大鬧天宮
programme.desc: Since the beginning of time, there existed in the world three clans; human, god and demon. As everything was destroyed during the great battle, Nuwa (Goddess of Works) used 36,500 magic boulders to repair Heaven. One of them fell accidentally down onto Earth and landed on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits on an island far across the Eastern Sea. Over thousands of years, the magic boulder absorbed the energies of Heaven and Earth and the sacred lights of the Sun and Moon. A godly creature was nurtured inside the stone-egg and a full-grown monkey burst out from it one day. When the Patriarch Subodhi passed by on his way to collect herbs in the Mountain, he came upon the monkey. Impressed by his exceptional wit and godly he took the monkey back to the Divine Cave of Three Stars in Mountain Mi to teach him the Way and called him Sun Wukong..

programme.title: 12.12：首爾之春
programme.desc: After the assassination of President Park, martial law has been declared. A coup d'etat bursts out by Defense Security Commander CHUN Doo-gwang and a private band of officers following him. Capital Defense Commander LEE Tae-shin, an obstinate soldier who believes the military should not take political actions, fights against CHUN Doo-gwang to stop him. The conflict between the two grows while military leaders are holding their decision and Defense Minister is gone. In the midst of chaos, the spring of Seoul that everyone longed for heads to unexpected direction.

programme.title: 爆谷電影現場
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: 告訴世界我來過
programme.desc: The 24-hour veterinary clinic acts like a bridge, witnessing the birth, separation, sickness and death of animals that human ever loved. On the contrary, also filled with our hope and despair. Some of their lives are in danger because of human's selfishness and ruthlessness. 'Once They Were Here ' tells the fate from different animals on the choice of human. Perhaps it is not pure love and random. The so-called equality of life is only reflected in the uninterrupted heartbeat.

programme.title: 藉著雨點再愛你
programme.desc: Along with his young son, Ji-ho, Woo-jin misses his wife Soo-a, who died after promising to return a year later with the rainy season. Miraculously, they reunite with Soo-a when the rainy season comes around, but she has no memory of her husband and son whom she dearly loved.
